findings.title: All food employees have food handler training
findings.comment:
410 ILCS 625 and IAC Section 750.3430 (C) Facility is not in compliance with the food handler law. All food handlers, other than someone who has the food service sanitation manager certificate, shall receive or obtain training in basic food handling principles as outlined in Subpart M of the Illinois Food Code. Food handlers working at a temporary food establishment are exempt from this requirement.  

Observed no food handler’s licenses for the facility. Discussed the need for all employees who handle the snack foods to have a food handler’s license. ANSI certified, valid for 3 years. Ensure all new hires obtain a food handler’s license within 30 day of employment. Correct by next routine inspection.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).  

There is a thick accumulation of slime on the lip of the ice machine deflector tray. Discussed with the PIC and it was cleaned during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria. 

The dish machine in the kitchen is not properly sanitizing. At first, the bottle of EcoSan was observed almost clear when it should be a yellow color. Discussion of the date marked on the bottle showed that it was a year old. The bottle was changed for a new one that appears to be correct. As the machine was ran after that, it did not appear that the machine was drawing from the bottle correctly. PIC contacted a trustee to have service conducted on the machine. The trustee arrived during the inspection and conducted maintenance on teh machine to get it to the correct sanitizing concentration.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. 

Test strips for the CL sanitizer in the dish machine were not available during the inspection. PIC is instructed to ensure that test strips are available for each sanitizer used for food related procedures in the facility. Test strips were acquired during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.citation_text:
3-501.17 (A) (Pf) Refrigerated, READY-TO EAT, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD prepared and held in a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date or day by which the FOOD shall be consumed on the PREMISES, sold, or discarded. The day of preparation shall be counted as Day 1.

Observed milk stored in the reach in cooler that has been opened without a date. A date was added during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.citation_text:
3-305.11 (A) (2) (C) Except as specified in ¶¶ (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination.
1) Black slime was observed on the deflector shield of the ice machine. 2) Dust build up was observed on the fan guard in the reach in cooler. The PIC is instructed to clean the items often enough so as to prevent build up.

findings.title: Dishwashing facilities designed, constructed, operated (1. wash 2. rinse 3. sanitize)
findings.comment: 750-830a Dish machines shall be properly installed and maintained in good repair. Dish machines shall be operated in accordance with the manufacturers instructions. Automatic dispensers and liquid injectors, if any, shall be properly installed and maintained. During the inspection, the dish machine was ran multiple times and tested for sanitizer concentration. After each time it was checked for sanitizer concentration and it was found to be 0 ppm. On the last check, observed the bottle of sanitizer currently connected to the machine to not be emptying. Suggested to the person in charge to contact Eco Lab to check the machine.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.comment: 750-1310 All toxic items must be properly stored (i.e. segregated from food) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all chemicals. Observed a bottle of degreaser stored over a food prep surface (griddle/ oven). This poses a potential risk of contaminating food prepared on this surface. Instructed person in charge to move the bottle to a different location not involved in food preparation.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.comment:
Observed 0ppm Chlorine in the dish machine. Repair the dish machine so that the chlorine level is 50ppm.  Nick from Ecolab met the inspector at the inspection and changed sanitizer to measure 50ppm.
750-830 All chemical sanitizers in a dish machine must meet the requirements of 21 CFR 178.1010 to ensure all items are properly sanitized.  Rinse water shall not less than 75F. Provide proper sanitizer concentration.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment:
Observed single service items not stored properly.  Make sure to store single service items in a way to prevent from cross contamination.
750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.
750-880 Single-service knives, forks and spoons packaged in bulk shall be inserted into holders to protect these items from contamination and present the handle of the utensils to the consumer unless the utensils are pre-wrapped or pre-packaged.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Observed some debris behind the oven/ cooking area.  Clean the floor.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.comment:

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed an absence of caulk at the three compartment sink.  Caulk the sink to the wall.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e: Observed old mouse droppings in one drawer in pre-school kitchen. The drawer was left open with a note pointing out the droppings, so drawer can be cleaned and sanitized. No other evidence of mice and Orkin pest control treats facility.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment: 750.1060: Observed a leak at both faucets on the 3 compartment sink, when the water is turned on. Repair leaks at both faucets.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment: .1060) kitchen (pre-school side) handsink drips and hot water faucet handle is hard to turn.  Repair faucet leak and handle so it's easy to turn on.
